caption_starter: La verdad es que tengo Jarvis v2 corriendo en n8n y Content Forge en Claude Code, así que hablo con autoridad: Claude se comió el caso de uso central de n8n.
_design_principle: ZERO TEXTO RASTERIZADO. Todos los slides usan textPayload:null. Los textos los aplica el compose-overlay vía SVG composite, garantizando legibilidad y consistencia tipográfica.

images.concept: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS in the image. Pure cinematic portrait. Deep black #050505 background with subtle warm radial terracotta glow centered behind subject. CENTER-RIGHT (55% of frame): a person standing 3/4 angle, mid-chest up, wearing solid matte black polo, calm serious authoritative gaze into camera. LEFT 45% of frame: a LARGE GLOWING TERRACOTTA ASTERISK SYMBOL (#D97856) — neon-style sculptural sharp edges, the official Claude logo, floating in mid-air at chest height of the person. To the right edge of the frame, smaller scale: a 3D VOXEL PIXEL-ART CHARACTER MASCOT in matte terracotta (#D97856), blocky cubic body with two dot eyes, standing on the floor at the person's hip level. Camera-left warm rim light wraps the person's jaw and shoulder in gold-terracotta. Top 30% empty deep black for headline overlay. Subtle film grain. NO TEXT anywhere — pure photographic render. 4:5 vertical.
images.composition: Claude asterisk left · person center-right · voxel mascot far-right small · top 30% empty · radial warm glow

images.concept: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS in the image. Pure visual scoreboard composition on deep black #050505 background. CENTER: two stacked horizontal bars representing scores — top bar wider in warm terracotta (#D97856) glowing, bottom bar narrower in muted gray (#3D3D3C). Between the bars: a thin gold accent line (#D4AF37). Around the bars: 8 small abstract category icons (gear, magnifier, lightning bolt, gear-arrow, terminal cursor, eye, file-doc, link) in a horizontal row at top, all in gold #D4AF37 outline only. The 3D voxel pixel-art Claude mascot in terracotta stands at small scale on the floor at right edge, looking up at the bars proudly. Soft radial terracotta glow centered behind bars fading to deep black. Top 30% empty for headline. Editorial dark boutique style. NO TEXT, NO NUMBERS rasterized — pure abstract score visualization. 4:5 vertical.

images.concept: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS. Deep black #050505 background. CENTER: the 3D voxel pixel-art Claude mascot in terracotta (#D97856) standing actively, both blocky arms extended outward as if having just severed connections. images.concept: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS. Deep black #050505 background. CENTER: the 3D voxel pixel-art Claude mascot in terracotta (#D97856) standing on a desk, beside it a CLOSED matte black voxel laptop with no glow. images.concept: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LETTERS, NO NUMBERS. Deep black #050505 background.
